summary_short.zh: PM Skills 是一个开源的产品管理技能市场，汇集超100个智能代理技能、命令和插件，覆盖产品发现、战略制定、执行、发布和增长全生命周期。其核心设计理念是将重复性工作模块化，通过可复用技能组件与Claude等AI助手无缝集成。例如，可一键调用用户访谈分析技能提炼洞察，或使用路线图规划技能生成优先级建议。技术亮点在于技能的“可组合性”，不同技能可像乐高拼接形成定制化工作流。产品经理无需从头编写提示词，直接安装社区验证技能即可提升效

summaries.en: PM Skills is an open-source marketplace of over 100 agentic skills, commands, and plugins designed to supercharge product managers with AI. It covers the full product lifecycle—from discovery and strategy to execution, launch, and growth. Technically, it provides reusable, composable skill modules that integrate with AI assistants like Claude, enabling PMs to automate tasks like user research, roadmap planning, and A/B testing. You can browse, install, and customize these skills to fit your workflow, or contribute your own to the community.

summary_short.zh: Skills 是 Google 开源的 Python 库，提供预置的 Google 产品技能模块，用于构建对话代理。它通过模块化设计将日历、邮件、地图等操作封装为可复用单元，解决从零集成 Google 服务的痛点。技术亮点在于技能架构：每个技能独立可测试，开发者可像搭积木般组合出复杂代理行为。可直接调用现有技能快速搭建原型，或编写自定义技能扩展功能，如用几行代码让代理读取 Gmail 或创建日历事件。适合需快速集成 Google 服务的 AI 应用开发者，尤其适用于个人助手或企业自动化工具。

summaries.en: Skills is an open-source Python library by Google that provides pre-built agent skills for integrating with Google products and technologies. It simplifies building conversational agents by offering modular, reusable components for tasks like accessing Google Calendar, Gmail, or Maps. The key technical insight is its skill-based architecture, which allows developers to compose complex agent behaviors from discrete, testable units. Practically, you can use Skills to quickly prototype agents that interact with Google services, extend it with custom skills, or contribute new ones to the community.

summary_short.zh: WhichLLM 是一款命令行工具，用于在本地硬件上自动测试并排名大语言模型的实际运行速度与效果。它不依赖参数数量或宣传数据，而是通过真实基准测试，在 Ollama 或 Hugging Face 上运行模型，并基于性能和时效性生成排行榜。用户只需一条命令即可测试多个模型，特别适用于 Apple Silicon、GPU 或 CPU 上的本地推理优化，快速筛选最适合设备的模型，避免手动试错。技术亮点在于“感知时效的基准测试”设计，确保推荐结果基于最新模型，可集成到开发流程中或用于比较不同量化版本（如 GGUF）

summaries.en: WhichLLM is a CLI tool that helps you find the best local LLM for your specific hardware by running real benchmarks, not just comparing parameter counts. It automatically tests models via Ollama or Hugging Face, ranks them by performance and recency, and outputs a clear leaderboard. Use it to quickly identify which model runs fastest and most accurately on your Mac, GPU, or CPU, saving hours of manual trial and error.
